export.detail: JSON, SFS, MusicXML and normalized re-import preserve the four-symbol profile, placement, independent event anchors and combinations with ties or authored slurs. No foreign payload, arbitrary mark identity, unsupported symbol or duplicated event-sign is silently discarded.

import.detail: Four empty MusicXML symbols with optional placement map to the typed model. Native SFS uses existing event-local articulation marks. Source-specific rejection covers each of the other 13 choices; shared schema types do not imply acceptance of their names or attributes. This does not cover repeated articulation containers within one notations wrapper, which are rejected rather than flattened.

model.detail: Typed ScoreArticulation and closed SimpleArticulation preserve event identity, absent/explicit placement, distinct chord members/voices/staves, old JSON compatibility and canonical order. Duplicate/invalid anchors fail. Authored slurs coexist without replacing either model.

playback.detail: Actual MusicXML → SFS → playback-plan tests reach the existing policy: staccato 50% gate, staccatissimo 25%, tenuto 100%, accent +16 attack with existing clamp. Written time is unchanged; chord members remain event-local; tied notes retain one attack/final-segment release. These are engine policy choices, not MusicXML-mandated or acoustic acceptance. Numeric-dynamics attack conflicts, fermata combinations and authored slur playback remain refused.

render.detail: Pinned Verovio 5.6.0 / Bravura SVG verifies four glyphs above/below, independent chord members/staves, combined marks and original selection identities. Staccatissimo uses the renderer default wedge E4A8/E4A9; no authored shape override is accepted. Rust-generated synthetic study/duet snapshots connect importer to actual rendering. Authored slurs still withhold the whole preview.

features.limitations: No styling/coordinates/glyph overrides, repeated identical signs, rest/unpitched/grace anchors or arbitrary native SFS attributes. All other 13 MusicXML choices reject on import and have no credited end-to-end contract. Slur combinations roundtrip but still withhold preview/playback; fermata-qualified playback and numeric-dynamics accent conflicts still reject. Synthetic fixtures, pinned Verovio SVG and modeled gate/velocity assertions do not establish complete external-score acceptance, acoustic fidelity, all instruments, platforms or performance interpretations. Repeated articulation containers within one notations wrapper are legal MusicXML but rejected by this bounded profile; container grouping/order, empty-group identity and authored stacking are not modeled. Untouched musicxmlTestSuite 32c acceptance is not established: non-mapped identification/miscellaneous metadata is an earlier independent boundary. The separate authored-articulations profile now models ordered grouping and all 17 choices under explicit opt-in; these facts do not change this default profile or its runtime boundary.
features.scope: Only staccato, staccatissimo, tenuto and accent as empty elements on measured pitched events, with absent/above/below placement. The 17 MusicXML 4.0 articulation choices are individually inventoried below; four bounded profiles are not whole-element or whole-family support. This is the default LegacySimple import/runtime profile; the explicit AuthoredV1 profile is independently recorded under authored-articulations.
features.title: Default legacy simple event articulations (separate from authored v1)

export.detail: Typed JSON/SFS/MusicXML roundtrip preserves all local authored data. Globally reserved source IDs survive generated native host normalization; MusicXML refuses nonterminating decimals and reports event association reordering rather than changing local stacking.

import.detail: Explicit AuthoredV1 option enables all 17 bounded choices and scalar SFS capability; default LegacySimple admission and unrelated boundaries remain unchanged. Exact string/decimal/enum validation and grace-wrapper scope checks prevent trimming or attr loss.

model.detail: Closed versioned typed choices preserve authored absence, independent placement/orientation, font and line fields, exact rationals, source IDs and event-local ordered wrappers/groups/items without foreign markup. Separate legacy lane and mixed-wrapper/anchor validation are explicit.

playback.detail: All authored v1 data remains without a sound policy. Core lowering/performed projection and ordinary or qualified grace/fermata entry points refuse it, including combinations on distinct hosts. Existing native simple policies are not reused for richer signs.

render.detail: Bounded Verovio 5.6.0 adapter renders seven ordinary signs with automatic/explicit placement and stroke-correct spiccato, stress and unstress only with explicit placement. Deterministic leaf/component IDs, ordered hierarchy receipts, independent orientation, duplicates, compound stacking, chord/voice/staff hosts and hidden print wrappers are verified in actual SVG. Visible coordinates/styles, seven other choices and unresolved glyph orientation refuse the exact object. The original all-17 synthetic Rust snapshot still refuses unchanged. Dormant pinned-SVG pause probes establish missing tick/upbow/Salzedo breath paths, empty symbol-based altsym output, short-note/second-chord horizontal anchor failures and thick-caesura extents across following-note columns/final barlines. These rejection receipts do not enable breath/caesura preview.

features.limitations: No same-event mixing with tied/slur/fermata or legacy articulation marks; no editorial footnote/level, rest/unpitched/grace anchors, other notation families, full Unicode source-ID/NMTOKEN profile, arbitrary XML or attribute bags. Decimal input retains the existing 64-character bound and MusicXML output needs finite decimals within 32 places and 64 characters; native rational values remain exact. All authored-v1 playback effects remain withheld. Engraving is limited to the documented ten ordinary signs, three requiring explicit placement; visible appearance/coordinate fields and seven other choices remain unsupported. Hidden known objects are intentionally not printed and remain in typed receipts. MEI note children are not a lossless serialization of source wrapper/group topology. No inferred breath/caesura timing, pitch transitions, instrument technique or velocity policy. Wrapper/group/item order is exact; top-level event-association order follows XML voice serialization with explicit normalization reporting and remains exact in native SFS. Synthetic snapshots/probes do not establish untouched 32c acceptance; its independent metadata boundary is unchanged. Breath/caesura projection remains entirely withheld: correct caesura glyphs and local vertical duplicate/compound separation do not establish safe after-note horizontal geometry. No simple-host whitelist or timestamp heuristic is shipped; see docs/AUTHORED_PAUSE_RENDERER_PROBES.md.
features.scope: MusicXmlOptions.articulations=AuthoredV1 only: all 16 defined MusicXML 4.0 choices plus passive other-articulation on measured pitched events. Ordered articulation-only notations wrappers/groups/items, repeated signs, empty groups and additional empty wrappers, optional source IDs/print-object, typed exact print-style and per-choice fields. Default import remains LegacySimple; representation/interchange plus bounded ordinary-sign engraving, not desktop-import-default or performance completion.

export.detail: Native association order is exact; XML reports association normalization, preserves local order, allocates slur numbers in authored order and rejects capacity overflow without sorting.

import.detail: Optional typed topology resolves local XML slurs without losing source child order; native required capability and reference validation preserve exact identities.

model.detail: Closed versioned topology references existing semantic payloads with exact host/wrapper/group/endpoint bijections and no raw XML.

playback.detail: No interpretation inferred from mixed optical topology. Ordinary and all qualified lowering profiles reject actual marks or declared capability, independently of header presence.

render.detail: Whole mixed preview is withheld unchanged, including actual Rust-pipeline snapshot and missing-header/future-kind guards.

features.limitations: Not a universal notation container: no rest/unpitched/grace articulation hosts, ornaments/technical/editorial children, richer tie semantics or duplicate fermatas. One-sided/continue/let-ring/repeat-conditioned/engraving ties still fail. Native tie overrides including explicit true flags reject. All optical and performance routes remain withheld; no external-score acceptance claimed. Existing decimal, source-ID and 16-live-slur XML capacity limits remain.

policy: Bounded reference baseline, never a claim to all music theory or all attributes/values of a linked declaration. Omitted entries/layers are unassessed, not unsupported or supported. Every partial/blocked layer requires executable evidence.
